lines.speaker: marra
lines.text: Stop there. Say who you're running from.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: The same people you're hiding from, by the look of you.

lines.speaker: tobin
lines.text: They burned the chapel library at Cold Ferry. Anyone who could read was taken.

lines.speaker: marra
lines.text: I'm a healer. He's a scholar, and a poor liar. We go where you go, if it's away from them.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: Stay behind the spears and keep close.
